title: Hospital appointment system
brief: An appointment system for a multi-speciality hospital. Patients register, search doctors by speciality, see available slots and book, reschedule or cancel appointments, and receive SMS and email reminders. Receptionists manage doctor schedules, leave and walk-in queues. Doctors see their daily list, view patient history and write e-prescriptions. Patient records are confidential and access must be audited. The hospital wants fewer no-shows and shorter waiting times.

requirements.title: Patient Registration and Search
requirements.description: Patients must be able to register accounts and search for doctors by speciality to find care.

requirements.title: Appointment Lifecycle Management
requirements.description: Patients and receptionists must be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments.

requirements.title: Automated Reminders
requirements.description: The system must send automated SMS and email reminders to patients for their upcoming appointments.

requirements.title: Doctor Schedule and Queue Management
requirements.description: Receptionists must manage doctor schedules, leave requests, and walk-in queues.

requirements.title: Clinical E-Prescriptions and History
requirements.description: Doctors must view daily lists, access patient history, and write e-prescriptions.

requirements.title: High Performance Search and Booking
requirements.description: Slot search and booking APIs must respond in under 500ms under peak load.

requirements.title: Confidentiality and Audit Logging
requirements.description: Patient medical records must be encrypted at rest and all record accesses must generate audit logs.

requirements.title: System High Availability
requirements.description: The appointment system must maintain 99.9% uptime during operational hours.

stories.title: As a patient, I want to register and search doctors by speciality so that I can find the right physician.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the registration page, when I submit valid details, then my account is created.
Given I am logged in, when I select a speciality, then I see a list of matching doctors.

stories.title: As a patient, I want to book an available slot so that I can secure an appointment.
acceptance_criteria: Given I view a doctor profile, when I select an open slot and confirm, then the appointment is booked.
Given I have a booked appointment, when I request a reschedule, then new slots are displayed.

stories.title: As a patient, I want to cancel my appointment so that the slot becomes available for others.
acceptance_criteria: Given I view my appointments, when I click cancel, then the appointment status updates to cancelled.

stories.title: As a patient, I want to receive SMS and email reminders so that I do not miss my appointment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an appointment is 24 hours away, when the reminder job runs, then an SMS and email are sent.
Given notification fails, when an error occurs, then the system retries delivery.

stories.title: As a receptionist, I want to manage doctor schedules and leave so that bookings match doctor availability.
acceptance_criteria: Given I access the schedule manager, when I add a leave period, then conflicting slots are blocked.
Given a walk-in patient arrives, when I add them to the queue, then their position is generated.

stories.title: As a doctor, I want to view my daily list and patient history so that I am prepared for consultations.
acceptance_criteria: Given I log in, when I open my daily list, then I see all assigned patients in chronological order.
Given I select a patient, when I view history, then past diagnoses and prescriptions are shown.

stories.title: As a doctor, I want to write e-prescriptions so that patients receive clear medication instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a patient consultation, when I submit prescription details, then an e-prescription is saved.

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want fast API responses so that users experience no lag during booking.
acceptance_criteria: Given high user traffic, when a search request is sent, then response time is under 500ms.
Given multiple concurrent bookings occur, when slots are checked, then race conditions are prevented.

stories.title: As a compliance officer, I want audit logs of record accesses so that patient confidentiality is enforced.
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor views a medical record, when the record opens, then an audit log entry is created.
Given data is stored in the database, when checked, then patient health records are encrypted at rest.

stories.title: As a hospital director, I want high system availability so that operations are never disrupted.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal hospital hours, when traffic spikes, then failover mechanisms keep the system online.
Given a server crash occurs, when redundancy triggers, then uptime SLA is maintained.

risks.title: Double-booking of time slots
risks.description: Concurrent booking requests for the same doctor slot could lead to double-booking.
risks.mitigation: Implement database-level pessimistic locking or serializable transactions on slot availability checks.

risks.title: Breach of patient medical records
risks.description: Unauthorized access or data leaks of confidential patient histories.
risks.mitigation: Enforce strict role-based access control, field-level encryption, and immutable audit logs.

risks.title: SMS and Email delivery failures
risks.description: External third-party gateway downtime causes patients to miss appointment reminders, increasing no-shows.
risks.mitigation: Use redundant notification providers with automatic failover and asynchronous retry queues.

modules.name: Patient Management Module
modules.responsibility: Handles patient registration, profile updates, and patient search functionalities.

modules.name: Scheduling Module
modules.responsibility: Manages doctor schedules, leave requests, walk-in queues, and slot availability.

modules.name: Appointment Lifecycle Module
modules.responsibility: Handles booking, cancellation, rescheduling, and state transitions of appointments.

modules.name: Notification Module
modules.responsibility: Dispatches automated SMS and email reminders to patients for upcoming appointments.

modules.name: Clinical Module
modules.responsibility: Manages doctor daily lists, patient medical history viewing, and e-prescription creation.

modules.name: Auditing and System Module
modules.responsibility: Enforces strict audit logging for patient data access and monitors system availability.

entities.name: Patient
entities.description: Represents a registered patient in the hospital system.

entities.name: Doctor
entities.description: Represents a physician with a specific medical speciality.

entities.name: Appointment
entities.description: Represents a booked slot between a patient and a doctor.

entities.name: MedicalHistory
entities.description: Contains clinical records and history for a patient.

entities.name: Prescription
entities.description: Contains e-prescription data issued during an appointment.

entities.name: AuditLog
entities.description: Records all access events to confidential patient records.

apis.summary: List doctor appointments for the day
Send automated SMS and email reminders
Create audit log entry for record access

tests.title: Patient registration and doctor search integration
steps: Send POST /patients with valid registration payload.
Verify 201 response and account creation.
Send GET /doctors?speciality=Cardiology and verify matching results.

tests.title: Appointment booking and rescheduling workflow
steps: Send POST /appointments to book an open slot.
Verify appointment confirmation.
Send PATCH /appointments/{id} to move to a new slot.

tests.title: Appointment cancellation
steps: Identify an existing booked appointment.
Send DELETE /appointments/{id} to cancel.
Verify status updates to cancelled.

tests.title: Automated notification reminder delivery
steps: Trigger reminder job for appointments 24 hours away.
Send POST /notifications to trigger SMS and email.
Verify successful delivery logs and retry on simulated failure.

tests.title: Schedule management and walk-in queue
steps: Access schedule manager to add doctor leave.
Verify conflicting slots are blocked.
Add a walk-in patient to queue and verify position number.

tests.title: Doctor daily list and patient history viewing
steps: Send GET /appointments for today to view patient list.
Send GET /patients/{id}/medical-histories to view past records.
Verify chronological ordering of visits and past diagnoses.

tests.title: E-prescription creation during consultation
steps: Open active patient consultation session.
Send POST /prescriptions with drug dosage and instructions.
Verify e-prescription is successfully stored.

tests.title: High concurrency doctor search performance
steps: Simulate high user traffic hitting search endpoint concurrently.
Send multiple GET /doctors requests simultaneously.
Verify average response time remains under 500ms.

tests.title: Medical record audit logging and security
steps: Access patient medical history without proper clearance to trigger security check.
Verify access attempt generates an audit log via POST /audit-logs.
Verify patient health data at rest is fully encrypted.

tests.title: System availability and failover resiliency
steps: Simulate primary database server crash during peak booking hours.
Trigger high-availability redundancy failover.
Verify active booking requests succeed without violating uptime SLA.

tests.title: Invalid appointment booking negative test
steps: Attempt to send POST /appointments for an already booked or non-existent slot ID.
Verify 400 Bad Request error response is returned.
Ensure no duplicate appointment is created.
